        Ordinary Council Meetings

        Council meetings are held on the fourth Thursday of each month (except for December meetings which are held on the third Thursday of the month). 

        Click the link to view the Schedule of Meetings:

        2026/ 2027 Schedule of Meetings

        Unless otherwise stated, Council meetings are held at the Council Chambers in Jurien Bay Administration Centre.  Council meetings commence at 4pm.

        Note - if Council meetings fall on a public holiday, the meeting will be held on the Wednesday prior.
